verifier_b.independent_derivation_or_calculation: Consider a rigid body rotating with angular velocity omega. A mass element dm at distance r from the axis has velocity v = r omega. Its kinetic energy is dK = 1/2 dm v^2 = 1/2 dm (r omega)^2. Integrating over the body: K = int 1/2 r^2 omega^2 dm = 1/2 omega^2 (int r^2 dm) = 1/2 I omega^2.
